source: Joico LumiShine Repair+ Demi-Permanent Liquid Color technical data sheet

numbering_system.description: Joico LumiShine Demi-Permanent Liquid shares the same numbering system as the Permanent line. Uses level number followed by tone letter code(s). No lift, deposit only.

lines.name: LumiShine Repair+ Demi-Permanent Liquid Color
lines.description: Ammonia-free, pH balanced demi-permanent liquid color. No lift, deposit only. For toning, refreshing, glossing, and grey blending. ArgiPlex and Quadramine Complex technology.

6_vol.use: Gentle deposit, grey blending, sensitive scalp

gray_coverage.rule: Grey blending, not full coverage. Provides subtle blending on level 6 and lighter.
gray_coverage.blending: Ideal for blending grey and adding tone without lift
gray_coverage.recommended: Use NN (Double Natural) or N (Natural) shades for best grey blending results

use_cases.toning: Neutralize unwanted tones on pre-lightened hair
use_cases.refreshing: Revive faded color between permanent services
use_cases.glossing: Add shine and subtle tone to natural or pre-colored hair
use_cases.grey_blending: Blend grey without full coverage using NN or N shades

processing_times.deeper_penetration: Up to 25 minutes for resistant hair
